title: Harbor Exchange Launch Decision
lead: Release the exchange in two stages. Keep the settlement hold until reconciliation is complete.
label: of pilot transactions reconciled
intro: The six-week pilot processed 1,250 synthetic transactions. Reconciliation matched 1,150; the remaining 100 need manual review before settlement can be enabled.
sections: Open account setup and order tracking on 14 July. Keep settlement disabled until the exception queue is empty and Finance signs the control record.
A single owner now resolves each exception. The support team has a tested escalation route, and the release can be rolled back without losing the review history.
Mara Chen owns reconciliation; Omar Diaz owns rollback readiness. Both report to the release lead at 09:00 on launch day.
closing: Decision due 10 July · Approve the limited scope, not settlement.
prompt: Use Dazzler to create a fictional professional document for its real reader task: Release the exchange in two stages. Keep the settlement hold until reconciliation is complete. Preserve the supplied numbers and qualifications. Develop a new release gate map composition, with a release boundary, with the unresolved settlement gate separated from the two ready services. Use Archivo in HTML and verified Arial for native Word. Make print and mobile reading clear; use purposeful #004EC4 color against #FFFFFF. Do not copy the earlier gallery layout.
colorDirection: Electric cobalt on white; the settlement decision owns the blue field.
